description: This file defines the 'Order' model class within the OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for retrieving order details, associated products, options, subscriptions, totals, and histories from the database, specific to customer orders.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: A model class that manages the retrieval of order-related data from the database, including order details, products, options, histories, and totals, for a customer's orders.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order by its ID, including payment and shipping zones and countries, and payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders for the current customer with pagination.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves orders associated with a specific subscription ID with pagination.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Gets options for a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription details for a specific order product.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total amounts related to a specific order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Gets the history records for an order, such as status updates.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total count of history records for a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProductId
methods.description: Returns total number of orders containing a specific product.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns total number of products in a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns total number of orders linked to a specific subscription.
